tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Confirm the Sous Chef MCP server is reachable.

tools.name: list_my_recipes
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved Sous Chef recipes. Use this before editing when the user refers to a recipe by name instead of id.

tools.name: display_recipe
tools.description: Presents a complete recipe in Sous Chef's interactive recipe card (servings, ingredients, steps, cooking mode, validated edits, Undo). Prefer this over plain chat formatting whenever you generate, retrieve, or substantially revise a full recipe — including ordinary requests like 'give me a vegan mus

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Returns the saved canonical recipe from your library or the public catalog. In-progress cooking edits live in sessions and are not returned here.

tools.name: add_recipe
tools.description: Creates a NEW recipe in your library only when the user explicitly asks to save/add it or taps Save in the recipe card. For a newly generated recipe the user has not chosen to keep, use display_recipe instead. Does not update existing recipes — to change a saved recipe use update_recipe. To make coo

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Deliberately updates allowed fields on a saved recipe in your library. Supports title, subtitle, summary, description, images, meta, and notes only; images and notes replace the whole array. Does not change ingredients or steps — use apply_recipe_patches for cooking-time edits in a session snapshot.

tools.name: apply_recipe_patches
tools.description: Validate and apply explicit edits. Pass recipeId for a persisted cooking session, or pass the full recipe payload from display_recipe to edit an unsaved card without persistence. Does NOT modify the saved recipe in your library.

tools.name: revert_recipe_edit
tools.description: Drop a patch group by requestId. Pass recipeId/sessionId for persisted edits, or pass the displayed card's baseRecipe and remaining patch history for a pure unsaved-card Undo. Unknown requestIds are idempotent no-ops.

tools.name: set_measurement_system
tools.description: Set measurements without ingredient patches. Pass recipeId for saved session state, or pass the full recipe payload from display_recipe to update an unsaved card without persistence.

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.description: Permanently delete a recipe owned by the authenticated user from their Sous Chef library. This cannot delete public catalog recipes.

tools.name: share_recipe
tools.description: Creates (or refreshes) a public Sous Chef link for a recipe and returns the URL. Only call when the user explicitly asks to share a recipe. The page is public, anyone with the link can view it, and it is indexed by search engines; the link shows the recipe as it currently looks, including Sous Chef

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: display_recipe, share_recipe · Public sink: share_recipe · Destructive: apply_recipe_patches, revert_recipe_edit, delete_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: display_recipe, share_recipe · Public sink: share_recipe · Destructive: apply_recipe_patches, revert_recipe_edit, delete_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
